description: P5-M3-T02 corpus pair list: (native sample, external-converter reference) pairs. The REFERENCE is the output of an external, independent converter (FreeCAD / Open CASCADE kernel via corpus/tools/gen_freecad_reference.py) reading the SAME native file. It is test-only ground truth for our own testing only: never a source of format internals (P5-M1-T03 clean-room line), never shipped, never claimed as the product. The harness measures a pair only when real geometry resolves on BOTH sides; a native CATPart whose external-converter reference is not yet mapped is an honest `reference-unavailable` skip, never a fabricated number.
